title: LLM knowledge for improved Out-of-Distribution Tabular Prediction - A Cross-Validated Regularisation Approach
abstract: arXiv:2610.36806v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prediction models degrade when the deployment population differs from the one used to train them, and training data cannot say which feature-response relationships will transfer. Expert elicitation is slow and unscalable. We ask whether coefficient priors elicited from large language models (LLMs) improve out-of-distribution (OOD) prediction as the shrinkage target of a regularised regression instead of zero, across five tabular datasets split on real covariates, selecting providers and prior structures by source-domain cross-validation alone. The priors help on four of five datasets, by up to 7.9% OOD mean squared error, and ten of twenty-four prior-informed results resolve the mean improvement at conventional confidence; single-deployment intervals are much wider. translated_title: 利用大语言模型知识改进分布外表格预测——一种交叉验证正则化方法
translated_abstract: 当部署人群与训练所用人群不同时，预测模型的性能会下降，而训练数据无法说明哪些特征-响应关系能够迁移。专家知识引导过程缓慢且难以规模化。我们研究由大语言模型（LLM）引导出的系数先验，作为正则化回归的收缩目标（而非收缩至零），能否改进分布外（OOD）预测。我们在五个表格数据集上按真实协变量进行划分，并仅通过源域交叉验证来选择模型提供者与先验结构。结果显示，先验在五个数据集中的四个上有所帮助，OOD均方误差最高改善7.9%；在二十四个使用先验的结果中，有十个在常规置信水平下呈现出显著的均值改进，而单一部署情形下的置信区间则宽得多。在分类任务上，增益体现在概率校准精度而非排序能力上；使用损坏先验的对照实验将这一收益归因于特征特定的内容，而非……
tldr: 该研究提出将从大语言模型引导出的系数先验作为正则化回归的收缩目标，仅通过源域交叉验证选择提供者与先验结构，即可在五个表格数据集上将分布外预测的均方误差最高改善7.9%。
en_tdlr: This study proposes using LLM-elicited coefficient priors as shrinkage targets in regularised regression—selected solely via source-domain cross-validation—improving out-of-distribution tabular prediction by up to 7.9% OOD MSE across five datasets.
